paper_title: Experimental search for invisible dark matter axions around 22 μeV
notes: Cavity haloscope excludes KSVZ axions (g_agamma >= 0.93 g_KSVZ) over 21.86-22.00 ueV at 90% CL. Coupling values estimated from KSVZ coupling (~8.4e-15 GeV^-1 near 22 ueV) scaled by 0.93. No exclusion table provided; values approximate. DM density 0.45 GeV/cm^3 assumed. Mass range 21.86-22.00 ueV = 2.186e-5 to 2.200e-5 eV.
